label: Two headless entrypoints: -z bypasses cli.py entirely; chat -q/-Q runs full HermesCLI init incl. MCP cold-start
-z stdout = final response only, no session_id line; exit 0/1/2/130; os._exit hard-exit guards SIGABRT
-z unconditionally sets HERMES_YOLO_MODE=1 + HERMES_ACCEPT_HOOKS=1 (auto-approve all); delegate_task routed inline
chat -q sets HERMES_SINGLE_QUERY_SESSION=1 → deterministic approvals.single_query_mode, default deny (fail-closed)
-Q prints response to stdout and 'session_id: <id>' to stderr; exit 0/1; usage error path exits 1 after init failure
--usage-file PATH writes JSON spend report even on failure; --run-budget caps wall-clock with 80% wrap-up
Live: no provider configured (no API keys, no OAuth); .env holds only tool/debug keys; smoke dispatch not permitted
Headless Hermes never blocks on an approval prompt: -z auto-approves, chat -q fails closed by default
